MagmafuryPassive

Eruption
Launch 1 Magma Geode at your target every 0.2 sec for 0.2 sec, dealing COND(GT(FireP, NatP), 58+5.0 Points Per Level+FireP*0.2, 58+5.0 Points Per Level+NatP*0.2) Firestorm Damage.

Duration increased by 0.2 sec for each stack of Earthshaping.
